title: Peace Pipeline System
dek: Heavy Reading's compiled map of Pembina's Peace Pipeline system: northeast BC Montney feed, the Fox Creek aggregation point, four segregated lines to Namao, and the Edmonton stream split (MPR to MSW, SPR to Medium Sour Blend, CPR + CPM to Condensate Blend).

claims.text: Peace is a segregated four-product system (ethane-plus, propane-plus, condensate, crude oil), each product in its own pipeline Fox Creek to Namao since Phase III entered service 2017-06-30.

At Edmonton, Peace Pipe Light (MPR) enters the Mixed Sweet Blend pool, Peace Pipe Sour (SPR) enters Medium Sour Blend, and Peace Pipe Condensate (CPR) plus Pembina Condensate (CPM) enter Condensate Blend (CRW).
claims.source: Enbridge Crude Oil Commodity Management Reference

claims.text: Pembina discloses Peace capacity only jointly with the Northern Pipeline: about 1.1 million b/d combined after Phase VIII (2024). No Peace-only capacity is published.
Taylor-to-Gordondale (89 km, 16-inch, mostly condensate) received its CER Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity on 2026-02-10; design up to about 118 kb/d; phased build, not in service.
claims.source: Pembina news release; CER certificate record
